preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The size of the array A is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in array A is either a non-negative integer or -1.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases will not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements in all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output is either a permutation of size N or -1
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a permutation of size N that satisfies the given conditions or -1 if no such permutation exists.
